name: print-social-why-choose-us-post-with-dotted-path-journey-and-green-glow
title: 'Why Choose Us?' post with a looping dotted path from logo to success over green light bars
whatItIs: A portrait black post with a pill logo and email, a large green uppercase 'WHY CHOOSE US?', and a looping dotted green path rising from 'Yourlogo' through 'Our Strategy', 'More Reach' and 'More growth' to 'Success', each with a green icon, over vertical light bars with a green glow at the bottom.
whatItMeans: Motivating and clear; the winding path turns a pitch into a journey.
techniques: Draw a looping dotted path as a journey.
Glow vertical light bars from the bottom.
Start the path at your logo.

vocabulary.definition: A path showing stages to a goal.
A marked point along a path.
